name: Barbell Seated Overhead Press
steps: Sit tall on a bench with feet planted firmly and hold a barbell across your front shoulders just outside shoulder width.
Brace your core, keep your forearms vertical, and tuck your chin slightly back.
Press the bar smoothly straight overhead until your arms extend with the bar balanced over your shoulders.
Lower the bar with control in front of your face back to your front shoulders.
tips: Keep your ribs stacked over your hips rather than arching sharply backward as you press.
Keep your wrists straight and stacked over your forearms throughout the lift.
